title: Protocol Observatory
subtitle: Send one prompt through three serving protocols. Same model, same Ollama daemon — different wire formats. Compare what each protocol gives you.
explainer: Ollama exposes /api/chat (native NDJSON), /v1/chat/completions (OpenAI-compatible SSE), and /v1/messages (Anthropic-compatible SSE). All three target the same local model — no cloud, no API keys. This page fires the same prompt through all three in parallel and shows what differs.

envelopeDiff.footnote: Observed values are from this run on your local Ollama. Some carriers (e.g. native NDJSON `done_reason`) only appear on the final chunk, while others (e.g. Anthropic `message_stop`) are dedicated events.
envelopeDiff.prefillRateStated: Prefill rate, as the daemon states it
envelopeDiff.statedNote: OpenAI-compat `timings.prompt_per_second` (Ollama 0.35.1+) divides the TOTAL prompt by the time spent on the UNCACHED tokens. On a warm cache it is inflated by the hit ratio; the row below divides by the tokens actually evaluated.
envelopeDiff.reasoningNote: Thinking shares the output budget with the answer. The native path only thinks when the request asks; the two compat paths let a thinking model think by default, so on the same prompt and the same budget they can run out before writing a word.
